# .github/skills — agent skills exported from the canon

## `roberto-twin`

Roberto's digital twin, packaged as a portable [Agent Skill](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/customize-copilot/add-agent-skills):
one `SKILL.md` + three on-demand files. It carries the **judgment layer** of roberdan-os —
operating loop, evidence-first verification, human gates, voice, reasoning method — and
explicitly *not* the local infrastructure (`kb`, `gbrain`, launchd, `private/`).

Derived by hand from `behavior/roberto-mode.md`, `identity/voice.md`,
`behavior/thinking-toolkit.md`, `rules/constitution.md`, `loop/loop-protocol.md` and the human
gates in `AGENTS.md`. **Not generated by `bin/sync.sh`** — same deal as `claude-ai-skill/`: if
the canon changes meaningfully, re-derive it rather than assuming it's still in sync.

### Where it works

| Surface | How to install |
|---|---|
| **Copilot Cowork / Copilot coding agent** | Already live for this repo (skills load from `.github/skills/`). For another repo: copy the `roberto-twin/` folder into that repo's `.github/skills/`. |
| **Copilot CLI / VS Code, personal scope** | `cp -R .github/skills/roberto-twin ~/.copilot/skills/` — available in every project. |
| **Claude Code** | `cp -R .github/skills/roberto-twin ~/.claude/skills/` |
| **claude.ai (upload)** | use `claude-ai-skill/` instead — that export is tuned for a sandbox with no repo. |

### How it activates

The agent loads it by matching the `description` in the frontmatter: any multi-step task,
drafting in his voice, a real decision, or an explicit "in roberto-mode" / "as my twin".
`SKILL.md` stays small on purpose; `ENGINEERING.md`, `VOICE.md`, `THINKING.md` and
`CONSTITUTION.md` are read only when the situation calls for them.
